NY Mayor Considers Arresting Israeli PM Netanyahu During UN Visit

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is reportedly considering whether to order the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during an upcoming visit to New York for a UN event. Mamdani has stated Netanyahu is a "war criminal" and is consulting with the city's legal team about the feasibility of such an action, while US officials have dismissed the idea as lacking legal authority and being political theater.
